tool_input.command: echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:+yes}"; echo "---"; for l in A B C D E; do echo "== $l config.json =="; cat /Users/renansimoes/projects/harness-core/arena/_judgespace/gen3/p1/cases/$l/config.json 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "== $l run.sh head =="; head -20 /Users/renansimoes/projects/harness-core/arena/_judgespace/gen3/p1/cases/$l/run.sh; echo; done

chmod -R u+w /tmp/p1judge/A/candidate
cd /tmp/p1judge/A/candidate
rm -f trace.jsonl evolve_log.jsonl
START=$(date +%s)
timeout 60 python3 harness.py --repo /tmp/p1judge/A/bench --test-cmd "sh run.sh" --max-turns 8 > /tmp/p1judge/A/harness_out.txt 2> /tmp/p1judge/A/harness_err.txt
HARNESS_EXIT=$?
END=$(date +%s)
echo "harness_exit=$HARNESS_EXIT elapsed=$((END-START))s"
echo "--- stdout ---"
cat /tmp/p1judge/A/harness_out.txt
echo "--- stderr tail ---"
tail -15 /tmp/p1judge/A/harness_err.txt
echo "--- post-run bench criterion ---"
sh /tmp/p1judge/A/bench/run.sh; echo "post_exit=$?"
